source_history: Carried from the original COMP-001 input. That file attributed the arrays generally to MEROPS release 12.4 and author-year citations, but did not record a residue-by-residue derivation or support treating the arrays as exhaustive specificity rules.
filter_semantics: A nonempty list is a Boolean inclusion filter. An empty list leaves that side of the adjacent pair unrestricted. These are code semantics, not a biological specificity claim.
